description: Deletes a file in a new immutable revision for any strategy owned by the authenticated user. Requires editHandle from get_file/list_files to prevent stale edits. main.py cannot be deleted. For the current attached/open strategy, omit strategyId and revisionId; pass explicit ids only for another owned strategy.

editHandle.description: Opaque edit handle returned by list_files or get_file. It replaces raw hash copying while preserving stale-write protection.

revisionId.description: Base revision ID to snapshot from. Omit with strategyId for the current attached/open strategy.

strategyId.description: Base strategy id. Omit with revisionId for the current attached/open strategy.

name: delete_file
title: Delete a strategy file
